# JotTune Synth

Compose, render, analyze and export locally from this player URL.
To make a song, read the [quick card](agent-quick.txt) and follow the
[authoring workflow](agent-start.txt). Return the verified .tl file and a
playable, release-pinned song URL. Keep the editable .score.json. Include WAV
when your environment can transfer audio. If you can only read pages, hand off
the score to the player and use its verification report before claiming success.

Preserve `score.metadata.license` through revisions and canonical export. The
portable field is `license`, not `licence`. For an original contribution whose
author explicitly approved CC0, use `CC0-1.0`. Never silently relicense a work.
A header supplies no separate publication or CC0/dataset/rights/age/history
consent. Private drafts may omit license; the teaching starter stays Apache-2.0.

- [Agent quick card](agent-quick.txt): compact score, pipeline and capability check.
- [Agent quickstart](agent-start.txt): supported browser and downloadable Node workflows.
- [Official client](agent.mjs): Node 22.15+, built-ins only, pinned local runtime.
- [Authoring](authoring.txt): score v1, recipes, musical time and native declarations.
- [Starter score](starter.score.json): editable teaching arrangement.
- [Portable TL document and metadata](tl-format.txt): versions, header fields, bounds and song identity.
- [Native TL](native-reference.txt): complete native syntax.
- [Parameters](reference/params.txt): generated units/ranges/dependencies.
- [Recipe catalog](reference/recipes.txt): complete presets, tweak units and spectral guidance.
- [Audio analysis](analysis.txt): measured PCM, advisory gates and optional dry sources.
- [Browser tools](browser-guide.txt): WebMCP-capable assistants can compose and verify with `intfm_compose` or render TL with `intfm_render`. The guide also covers `window.IntFM` and file export.
- [Library](songs.json): examples, exact saved variants and attributed metadata.
- [Static checksums](agent-manifest.json) and [renderer registry](engines.json):
  artifact integrity and kept versions; same-origin hashes are not independent authenticity.

All URLs stay relative to this player base. Creating and rendering a song is
local. This player does not upload songs.
For offline work, retain a complete cache from online setup, or use `--bundle`
with a complete trusted bundle when supplied. A bundle can initialize a cold
cache without network setup. Offline use cannot establish current revocation.
A render with a computed hash is not full verification. Score solo/mute is a rerender through effects,
not additive mix stems. No genre, loudness or width target is prescribed.
